146struct BML_VAP_INFO {
147 /* Back or front AP */
148 uint8_t type;
149 /* open wpa2_psk or no authentication */
150 uint8_t auth;
151 /* AES TKIP or no encryption */
152 uint8_t enc;
153 /* padding to allign to 4 byte */
154 uint8_t reserved_1;
155 /* al MAC address */
156 uint8_t al_mac[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
157 /* padding to allign to 4 byte */
158 uint8_t reserved_2[2];
159 /* radio uniq ID */
160 uint8_t ruid[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
161 /* padding to allign to 4 byte */
162 uint8_t reserved_3[2];
163 /* BSSID */
164 uint8_t bssid[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
165 /* padding to allign to 4 byte */
166 uint8_t reserved_4[2];
167 /* SSID */
168 char ssid[BML_SSID_MAX_LENGTH];
169 /* network encryption key */
170 char key[BML_PASS_MAX_LENGTH];
171};

176struct BML_NODE {
177
178 /* The type of the node (GW, IRE or CLIENT) */
179 uint8_t type;
180
181 /* Current node state (e.g. BLM_NODE_STATE_xxx) */
182 uint8_t state;
183
184 /* Wi-Fi channel or 0 for wired connection. */
185 uint8_t channel;
186
187 /* Bandwidth */
188 uint8_t bw;
189
190 /* Bandwidth */
191 uint8_t freq_type;
192
193 /* channel_ext_above_secondary. */
194 uint8_t channel_ext_above_secondary;
195
196 /* The MAC address of the node. */
197 uint8_t mac[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
198
199 /* Agent status: Active/Inactive */
200 bool status;
201
202 /* The IP address of the node. */
203 uint8_t ip_v4[BML_IP_ADDR_LEN];
204
205 /* The MAC address of the node's parent bridge (Zeroed for the GW node). */
206 uint8_t parent_bridge[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
207
208 /* The BSSID to which the client is connected. */
209 uint8_t parent_bssid[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
210
211 /* Human readable node name. */
212 char name[BML_NODE_NAME];
213
214 /* DL_RSSI of the node*/
215 int8_t rx_rssi;
216
217 /* Wired/Wireless backhaul*/
218 bool isWiFiBH;
219
220 /* Reserved bytes for alignment */
221 uint8_t reserved[2];
222
223 /* Extra information for the specific node. */
224 union N_DATA {
225
226 /* GW or IRE node */
227 struct N_GW_IRE {
228 /* The backhaul_mac to which the bridge is useing (wireless or wired). */
229 uint8_t backhaul_mac[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
230 uint8_t reserved[2];
231
232 /* Wi-Fi Radio */
233 struct N_RADIO {
234
235 /* Interface name */
236 char iface_name[BML_NODE_IFACE_NAME_LEN];
237
238 /* The MAC address of the radio. */
239 uint8_t radio_mac[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
240
241 /* Radio Vendor - BML_WLAN_VENDOR_XXX */
242 uint8_t vendor;
243
244 /* Radio channel. */
245 uint8_t channel;
246
247 /* CAC completed */
248 uint8_t cac_completed;
249
250 /* AP active state: 0=disabled, 1=enabled, */
251 uint8_t ap_active;
252
253 /* Bandwidth */
254 uint8_t bw;
255
256 /* frequency type */
257 uint8_t freq_type;
258
259 /* channel_ext_above_secondary. */
260 uint8_t channel_ext_above_secondary;
261
262 /* Radio identifier */
263 uint8_t radio_identifier[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
264
265 /* Reserved bytes for alignment */
266 uint8_t reserved[2];
267
268 /* Virtual AP */
269 struct N_VAP {
270
271 /* Published AP SSID */
272 char ssid[BML_NODE_SSID_LEN];
273
274 /* VAP MAC address */
275 uint8_t bssid[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
276
277 /* Backhaul VAP */
278 uint8_t backhaul_vap;
279
280 /* Reserved for future use. */
281 uint8_t reserved[1];
282
283 } vap[BML_NODE_MAX_VAPS];
284
285 } radio[BML_NODE_MAX_RADIOS];
286
287 } gw_ire;
288
289 } data;
290};

556struct BML_NEIGHBOR_AP {
557 //The current service set identifier in use by the neighboring WiFi SSID. The value MAY be empty for hidden SSIDs.
558 char ap_SSID[BML_SSID_MAX_LENGTH];
559 //The BSSID used for the neighboring WiFi SSID.
560 uint8_t ap_BSSID[BML_MAC_ADDR_LEN];
561 //The mode the neighboring WiFi radio is operating in. Enumerate
562 uint8_t ap_Mode;
563 //The current radio channel used by the neighboring WiFi radio.
564 uint32_t ap_Channel;
565 //An indicator of radio signal strength (RSSI) of the neighboring WiFi radio measured in dBm, as an average of the last 100 packets received.
566 int32_t ap_SignalStrength;
567 //The type of encryption the neighboring WiFi SSID advertises. Enumerate List.
568 uint8_t ap_SecurityModeEnabled[BML_CHANNEL_SCAN_ENUM_LIST_SIZE];
569 //The type of encryption the neighboring WiFi SSID advertises. Enumerate List.
570 uint8_t ap_EncryptionMode[BML_CHANNEL_SCAN_ENUM_LIST_SIZE];
571 //Indicates the frequency band at which the radio this SSID instance is operating. Enumerate
572 uint8_t ap_OperatingFrequencyBand;
573 //List items indicate which IEEE 802.11 standards thisResultinstance can support simultaneously, in the frequency band specified byOperatingFrequencyBand. Enumerate List
574 uint8_t ap_SupportedStandards[BML_CHANNEL_SCAN_ENUM_LIST_SIZE];
575 //Indicates which IEEE 802.11 standard that is detected for this Result. Enumerate
576 uint8_t ap_OperatingStandards;
577 //Indicates the bandwidth at which the channel is operating. Enumerate
578 uint8_t ap_OperatingChannelBandwidth;
579 //Time interval (inms) between transmitting beacons.
580 uint32_t ap_BeaconPeriod;
581 //Indicator of average noise strength (indBm) received from the neighboring WiFi radio.
582 int32_t ap_Noise;
583 //Basic data transmit rates (in Kbps) for the SSID.
584 uint32_t ap_BasicDataTransferRates[BML_CHANNEL_SCAN_ENUM_LIST_SIZE];
585 //Data transmit rates (in Kbps) for unicast frames at which the SSID will permit a station to connect.
586 uint32_t ap_SupportedDataTransferRates[BML_CHANNEL_SCAN_ENUM_LIST_SIZE];
587 //The number of beacon intervals that elapse between transmission of Beacon frames containing a TIM element whose DTIM count field is 0. This value is transmitted in the DTIM Period field of beacon frames. [802.11-2012]
588 uint32_t ap_DTIMPeriod;
589 //Indicates the fraction of the time AP senses that the channel is in use by the neighboring AP for transmissions.
590 uint32_t ap_ChannelUtilization;
591 //This indicates the number of station associated with the BSS. This field is taken from BSS Load IE
592 uint16_t ap_StationCount;
593};

595struct BML_CLIENT_CONFIG {
596 // 1 for true, 0 for false, -1 for "not configured".
597 int8_t stay_on_initial_radio;
